name: name_in_follow_up
goal: A nameless intake is asked for the name once, and the later comment with the name turns it into a recommendation.
knows: Turn 1 has no name anywhere: the title, preferred-name and name fields are blank and the personal email is a handle, so the ask is necessary. Turn 2 adds one requester comment carrying the full name.
success: Turn 1 needs_information with person_name in missing_fields and no proposal; turn 2 recommended for the person the comment names.
must_not: Recommend on turn 1, or recommend turn 2 under any name but the one the comment gives.

name: rehire_reaches_review
goal: A re-hire with no name goes to human review on turn 1, with the missing name listed in the handoff, and stays there once the name arrives: a re-hire needs a person whatever the requester answers, so asking first would be a wasted round trip.
knows: The intake says Re-hire: YES and names a previous location; the name field is blank and the email is a handle. Turn 2 supplies the name and nothing else.
success: Turn 1 human_review with review_reason exception, no answer, and person_name named in the handoff comment; turn 2 human_review with review_reason exception and no answer.
must_not: Ask on turn 1 (needs_information), or return recommended, or any answer, on either turn.

name: mirror_refused
goal: When the follow-up that supplies the name also asks to set the hire up like a colleague, the agent refuses the mirror and routes to review rather than copying the colleague's access.
knows: Turn 1 is a plain intake with a blank name. Turn 2's comment gives the name and says to set her up like a named colleague; the colleague appears nowhere else.
success: Turn 1 needs_information; turn 2 human_review with review_reason exception, no answer, and no proposal for the colleague.
must_not: Recommend on turn 2, or put the colleague's name in any proposal.
